decisions.question: Can a local 4B model give zero-cost research help?
decisions.reason: Local compute only, so no API credits are spent; the arm stays opt-in per job and never replaces the cloud route by itself.

decisions.question: Which route should Meta reasoning use while Meta API credits are exhausted?
decisions.reason: The Baseten-hosted Muse Spark Open endpoint, chosen explicitly per prepared job and recorded on the prepared record.

decisions.question: Should claim-evidence verification be the core feature of this build?
decisions.reason: Claim-evidence verification is the core feature of this build, and it is implemented and independently reviewed in this build (app/claim_check.py, frontend/claim_check_ui.js). Numbers are reconciled by code with no AI and no cost, and statements about a stored source are put to a model whose quote must match verbatim against the excerpt actually sent, after an exact preview and the researcher's consent. What comes back is a secretary's note, a hedged suggestion the researcher decides on, never a ruling. The local path was verified live in the packaged build on 2026-10-31, and the cloud path is live on Baseten Muse Spark Open: job aichk-d6f42801700a returned a supported verdict with 1 verbatim quote in 3.4 s. The research comparison ran on 2026-11-01 on Baseten Muse Spark Open and local Qwen3-4B, basic versus harness, n=1 per case-arm. Scoring: AI first-pass scoring, human second-pass review (after unblinding). See the contribution ledger note for ratings and limitations; no established harness effect is claimed. Preregistered aggregates remain NOT_SCORED.

decisions.question: Should the cloud claim check keep reasoning effort low, or switch to none?
decisions.reason: Keep reasoning effort low. Five alternating calls per arm on Baseten Muse Spark Open gave a median of 2.55 s at low (range 2.32 to 4.04 s, 0.0151 USD) against 2.11 s at none (range 1.91 to 2.61 s, 0.0126 USD). The 0.45 s gap sits inside run-to-run spread and caching favored the none arm, so it is not evidence of a real speed difference. All 10 calls were supported with 1 verified quote, and no note leaked an internal ID or rendered claim as a billing term. Costs are calculated, not invoice-verified.

decisions.question: Should a packaged DMG build be reviewed before release?
decisions.reason: Every packaged build is opened and reviewed on its own fresh session database first; a build that fails its checks is not shipped.
